text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Me, appearing
on Curren's stream?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Pretty please♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh... N-No way. Someone like me is basically
a total nobody. There's no demand for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Seeing a side of Nature-san
that's completely different from the races...
all your fans will be thrilled♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuugh...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I actually accepted.
Man oh man... what am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I'm just an ordinary horse girl who doesn't
have special talents or witty talk.
...What am I gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
F-For now... at the very least,
I should try to pick up some kind of trick
I can show off on stream—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, how about something like this?
Those "Dance Cover" videos people always talk about.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Then again, literally every girl at Tracen Academy
can dance... Doing this really just looks like
I'm blindly giving it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. So this is how you do
natural makeup—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
............ No, seriously,
this is way too natural. It doesn't even
look like anything changed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~♪ You're a bad person~♪
That's right~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Even I know this is old. Basically all the songs
I'm good at were released before I was even born.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... I give up. I really don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Nature?
If you sigh, all your happiness will run away!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... it's just, I kind of realized
I'm totally useless at everything.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
? I don't really get it,
but Nature is ALWAYS the best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You help me study! You solve my problems!
And your running is amazing! You're always the best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming today!
Nature-san, you look
so refreshed today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It feels like a weight's been lifted off my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I worried over all sorts of things—
but in the end, I realized I just need to be my usual self.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like trying makeup, or dance covers,
or singing covers. I did trial and error
and practiced all kinds of stuff, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eh? You practiced that much for this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, let's totally do all of that
on stream today!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? N-No, wait, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will absolutely love it!
Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Here's my dance cover...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ummm, s-so this is my natural makeup routine...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~♪ The horse pa~ath~,
endless~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... H-Hey... is this really okay?!
Is there seriously any demand for this?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Tons of demand♪
Look, check out the chat!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Hardworking Nature is so lovable!"
"Knowing she practiced just for today
totally melts my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...They saw right through everything?!
What is this, is everyone in chat psychic?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. It just means everyone loves you
so much that they can read you like a book♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This stream gathered a huge audience
and became a hot topic across the academy.
